verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents a public developer platform at developers.heygen.com. It offers REST, CLI and MCP access, API keys with scoped read/write permissions, and concrete endpoints such as POST /v3/models/videos. Batch APIs with webhooks are also documented, and a live llms.txt probe returned HTTP 200. Missing for 10: no OpenAPI/Swagger spec was found at the standard paths (all probed paths returned 404, despite claimed typed schemas), and there is no independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: From API key to your first video in minutes
Map restricted API key read and write scopes to the public endpoints that require them.
